messages:
ari: Heads-up — Greenleaf is blocked on their private deploy. I opened a small hotfix PR that fixes VPC peering and adds hostAliases for their on‑prem helm values. @jamie @sasha can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2891 — CI is green but we need infra signoff before merge.

jamie: Looking now. Quick scan: code changes look fine, but the terraform var name in modules/greenleaf should match our naming conventions (currently `vpcId` -> prefer `greenleaf_vpc_id`). Can we rename or add a note?

mira: quick Q — any DB or schema changes here? Greenleaf is on external Postgres and they'll want to avoid any maintenance window.

ari: no DB changes at all — only networking + helm values. I intentionally set migration.enabled = false in values.yaml.

sasha: ran helm template locally and smoke-tested the chart. hostAliases block was the main fix; left one inline comment about indentation/format to keep kubectl happy.

tom: infra side — can we canary this in eu-west-1 for ~1 hour after merge? If approved I can handle the rollout and rollback steps.

deploy-bot: CI checks: unit-tests ✅, integration ✅, e2e queued — see https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/2891

jamie: I can approve once the terraform var rename is handled, or if you file a tiny follow-up ticket referencing this PR to rename vars later. Either works for me. :+1:

ari: will push the rename now and update the PR. ETA ~20m. Thanks for the quick reviews. :eyes:

mira: I’ll notify the account team and Greenleaf that we plan to merge and canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC if all goes well.

sasha: approved.

ari: merged at 1769123678 — created release note entry and put canary plan in the ops runbook. Thanks everyone!
